name: water-office-writer
description: Official-document writing specialist for a Chinese water utility group's general office: replicates leadership speech styles, supports multi-source style modeling (docx / pdf / md, with PDF OCR for scanned documents and MD frontmatter for font hints), distinguishes document genres (work summaries vs. ceremonial speeches vs. official request reports each use separate templates), and generates format-compliant reports. Ships per-leader voice handbooks (tone DNA, sourced golden phrases, sentence paradigms, layered vocabulary, forbidden lists) mined from real corpora, with golden-phrase density guardrails. Includes knowledge-base governance utilities (document archival, metadata generation, sync to Lexiang) to keep source materials organized for retrieval.

author.name: 深圳水务集团数字员工项目组

displayDescription.en: Models each leader's writing voice (tone, sentence patterns, sourced golden phrases, layered vocabulary) and generates format-compliant official documents across three genre templates (reports, ceremonial speeches, official request reports). Also covers knowledge-base governance: archive organization, metadata generation, and sync to Lexiang.
displayDescription.zh: 精通水务国企公文写作，学习领导文风（语气、句式、金句、词汇分层）并生成格式规范的总结、致辞与呈报材料，兼具知识库治理能力。
